I'm a collector of old banknotes and today I bought something unique. A booklet from a very old bank with ten silver one notes that you tear out like checks. I will post pictures on mildly interesting soon, but for now I'm just wondering if anyone's ever heard of such a thing. It's dated 1963.
Help me v/whatever, you're my only hope

Very interesting find! I collect silver coins and other older US currencies. I have not heard of the notes being bound in a booklet before. Regarding silver certificates and other rare currency, usually it does not hold much value beyond face value if it is more recent than 1900. For silver certificates, they stopped circulating in 1964, so you have some of the last that were produced.

The fact that most of those have not been in circulation and appear to be in like-new condition, you may be able to get a few times more than face value, depending on the buyer. I would recommend visiting a nearby coin shop; they often have knowledge about the value of those, but they will also low-ball an offer to you.

Good luck!
